notes: Real INSEE MOBPRO 2021 commune-to-commune home-to-work flow totals are used directly (same source and commune pairs as our mainland France maps). No official fine-grained population/employment grid exists for this overseas territory (no Filosofi-equivalent), so within each commune, residents and jobs are placed on a synthetic ~275m grid weighted by OpenStreetMap building floor area (capped at the 95th percentile so no single large building absorbs a whole district's population). Real INSEE commune-level population totals anchor the residential side. Special demand points (airport, university, hospital, port, cruise terminal, industrial zone) use real sourced figures (passenger traffic, enrollment, bed counts) rather than estimates. — Reviewer confirmation (2026-08-23): answers accepted exactly as filed; the self-classification is accurate throughout (MOBPRO commune totals and full matrix kept; both pillars honestly dropped to commune-grain OSM-size placement). FLOOR EXCEPTION applied per the Quality Floor policy: guadeloupe scores low against the FR floor of medium, but the floor exists to stop low-quality duplicates of well-covered cities — this is a previously uncovered territory, and INSEE publishes no Filosofi carreaux for Guadeloupe (coverage is mainland + Martinique + Réunion, matching exactly where the author used the grid), so commune-grain is the best officially available resident/workplace grain here.
